genre: Puzzle / Nonogram (Picross) with a cozy renovation meta
title: Nonogram Atelier
audience: Nonogram fans (25-65, skewing 35+, global) who want a premium, calm, ad-respectful, offline-friendly logic ritual. Also cozy-decor players who enjoy completing art and restoring spaces, and bedtime or commute solvers who keep daily streaks.
controls: Tap cycles or sets the cell by the active tool (Fill / X / Dot), with an explicit toggle that shows the active state. Hold and drag paints a continuous line along one row or column. The axis locks after about 8 px, and a live counter shows the run length (e.g. "+7"). Error-prevention snapping is optional and only snaps the sweep to a single axis. It never changes the cell's correctness. Pinch zooms and two-finger drag pans. Grids of 10x10 and up auto-fit at a minimum tap target of about 7.5 mm, and 15x15 and up auto-zoom to the working region. Precision mode shows an offset cursor with a magnifier loupe and a confirm lift. Undo and redo are free and unlimited. There is a long-press-to-erase option and a left-handed mode. Dot and Note modes serve as marks. Haptics are soft ticks and can be switched off.
core_loop: 1) Pick a puzzle from an island or the daily. 2) Solve with tap, hold or drag using clue logic and auto-X. 3) The picture reveals in ink or color with a satisfying completion animation. 4) Earn Pigments (soft currency) and a framed artwork. 5) Spend Pigments and finished art to renovate rooms of the atelier, which unlocks the next story beat and cosmetics. 6) A daily puzzle and a forgiving streak bring the player back tomorrow. Next puzzle is one tap and never blocked.
ui_screens: Puzzle Screen (sticky clues, tool toggle, undo, hint, zoom)
Puzzle Complete (reveal, Pigments, Next puzzle instantly)
Settings (themes, dark/high-contrast/colorblind, haptics, sound, left-hand, hide meta, strikes mode, cloud save)
positioning: The calm, honest, beautiful nonogram app. Every puzzle is a painting and every painting restores your atelier. Everything is unlocked from the start. There are no strikes by default, no energy and no timers. Ads are rare and skippable. A one-time $3.99 ad-free purchase removes every ad, popup and nag. The meta layer (atelier, events, collections) is fully optional and can be hidden in settings.
progression: Players earn Pigments from every solved puzzle (more for larger grids and for no-hint solves) and unlock framed artworks. Each island's Masterwork finishes a room of the atelier (Entryway, Sketch Loft, Print Press, Sculpture Hall, Conservatory, Kiln Room, Lantern Gallery, Observatory Studio, Rooftop Garden, Grand Exhibit). Story beats with the curator cat Mina and the old master Ostrava unfold at room completion. Three-star goals per puzzle are no hints, no undo-count-limit, and a speed bonus that is never required. Collections cover artworks, frames, brushes and tile sets, and these are unlocked directly with Pigments or by completing set goals. There is no random reward. A daily streak with a free monthly Streak Freeze keeps the streak from breaking, and Pigment recovery covers missed days. The player can hide the whole atelier layer in settings.

level_structure: The campaign has 10 islands (chapters) of 14 handcrafted puzzles each, 140 total, in themed packs. Each pack ends with a larger Masterwork puzzle that completes a framed artwork. Sizes run from 5x5 to 30x30 with free choice from the start: a Free Play library with filters by size, difficulty, color count and theme is open from the first launch. Each puzzle takes 1-5 minutes for small grids, and large grids are saved and resumable. Every puzzle is verified by a line-solver to have a unique solution with no guessing. Daily puzzle, weekly Gallery events and a Creator Studio (create and share) sit alongside the campaign.
difficulty_curve: Islands 1-2 are gentle and teach the basics. The first breather comes after island 1 with a relaxed Masterwork. Spikes land at puzzle 10 of islands 3, 5, 7 and 9, where a new mechanic combines with earlier ones. After each spike comes a breather island pack with easy "comfort" pictures. Difficulty is rated 1-5 on solver depth, such as the number of line-pass cycles and the need for overlap reasoning, rather than on grid size alone. Every 5th puzzle is a relaxed picture. The Masterwork of islands 4, 7 and 10 is the toughest of its chapter. Hints always explain the logic in plain words, and an optional adaptive suggestion offers an easier pack after repeated abandons. Nothing is ever locked behind difficulty.
camera_orientation: Portrait only, one-handed. The grid is a 2D Skia canvas with sticky clue headers that stay visible while panning and zooming. The tool toggle (Fill / X / Dot), undo, hint and zoom controls sit in the bottom 35% thumb zone. Left-handed mode mirrors the toolbar. The atelier hub is a gently parallaxed 2.5D cutaway studio that scrolls vertically.
market_opportunity: Nonogram demand is evergreen: the head keyword leader has about 50M installs. Reviews show unmet needs: forced ads, tiny tap targets, strike systems, clutter and no dark mode. A trustworthy premium-feel app can win long-tail ASO ("nonogram puzzles", "picross", "color nonogram", "logic puzzles offline"). Revenue comes from a cheap ad-free purchase, cosmetic atelier packs and an optional season pass. Virality comes from shareable finished artworks, friend-made puzzle sharing and daily-result sharing.
competitor_contrast: Nonogram.com has huge variety but heavy interstitials, a dice-race gimmick, popups that survive the ad-free purchase, and a bright UI. Atelier caps interstitials at 1 per 4+ puzzles with none before puzzle 6 or the first 10 minutes. It has no chance mini-games, and ad-free removes all nag UI. Picross S has great feel but little meta. Atelier adds studio-grade art and a renovation meta without gating any puzzle. Nonograms Katana has a plain UI, repeating pictures and weak zoom. Atelier uses hand-authored recognizable pictures, a solver-verified no-guess guarantee, and zoom with a precision-tap mode. Versus Two Dots-style event meta, Atelier events take 10-15 minutes a day and missed rewards can be recovered.
economy_monetization: Currencies: Pigments (soft, earned by solving) and Hint Brushes (earned free: 3 per day plus puzzle rewards; extra via opt-in rewarded ad). No lives, energy or timers. Hints reveal a single chosen line or a player-picked cell and always explain the logic. Monetization: (1) a one-time Atelier Premium purchase at $3.99 that removes ALL interstitials, banners, popups and promo nags, restores across devices, and survives reinstall and updates; (2) optional cosmetic packs (frames, brushes, ink themes, room styles) at $0.99-$4.99 that are also earnable in game, so there is no gacha and no paid random rewards; (3) an optional season pass of cosmetics at $4.99 with no gating of puzzles; (4) opt-in rewarded ads for extra hints. Interstitials: none before puzzle 6 or the first 10 minutes, then at most 1 per 4+ completed puzzles and 1 per 5 minutes, always at puzzle completion only. Never at app open, restart, pause, mid-puzzle or on a mistake. A close button shows within 5 seconds and ads are never chained. Ads respect mute. A load failure falls back to the game. Non-personalised ad filtering blocks scam, adult and violent categories. Declining a rewarded ad never leads to another ad.
technical_assumptions: React Native with Skia and Reanimated; a 30-60 fps cap, static UI and a battery budget under 5% per hour
Offline-first with an autosave on every move and cloud sync (account sign-in via platform services) to restore on a new device
Bundled line-solver validates uniqueness and no-guess solvability for every puzzle in tooling; the puzzle format is a compressed grid plus a palette
Ad SDK with category filtering and mute-respecting audio; interstitials preloaded but never shown on the blocked moments
Entitlement stored server-side and via platform receipts; restore purchases across devices
Remote config for events and daily puzzles; local fallback calendar when offline
Accessibility: dark and high-contrast themes, colorblind-safe palettes with pattern glyphs, scalable fonts, separate clue digit spacing
qa_acceptance_criteria: Misclick rate below 3% for a thumb on a 6-inch phone on 20x20 grids
Undo is free and unlimited; strikes mode is off by default and persists once toggled
No interstitial before puzzle 6 or the first 10 minutes, then at most 1 per 4+ completed puzzles and 1 per 5 minutes; never at app open, restart, pause or mid-puzzle
A close button appears within 5 seconds of any ad, and an ad load failure never blocks the game
After the premium purchase, zero ads or popups across 50 puzzles; it restores on a new device and after reinstall
Killing the app mid-ad or mid-puzzle restores the grid exactly
Auto-X and clue grey-out are accurate on all sizes and can be switched off
Every puzzle has a unique solution that solves by logic alone (solver-verified)
Dark, high-contrast and colorblind-safe modes are available at launch; no red/green-only cues and no red error flashes
Next puzzle works instantly with no animation lock over 1 second
Meta layers can be hidden in settings, never gate a puzzle, and daily goals never exceed 15 minutes
Battery use under 5% per hour and a modest temperature rise over 30 minutes on a mid-tier device
Mute and haptic settings are honored everywhere, including ads
store_listing_strategy: Title: "Nonogram Atelier: Picross Art". Lead keywords: nonogram puzzles, picross, color nonogram, logic puzzles offline. Screenshots show the thumb-friendly zoomed grid, a reveal animation, dark mode, the atelier renovation and a "no strikes, no timers, fair ads" badge. The short description and the listing copy call out one-time $3.99 ad-free, offline play and cloud save. Launch with 140+ puzzles, a daily puzzle and the Creator Studio. Run seasonal Gallery events.
